objects.title: The Two-Person Market
objects.summary: A 26-gate working architecture for a market that can add independent producers without requiring every successful company to become a larger organisation.
boundaries: Not an operating network, franchise offer, investment offer, validated business model or launch announcement.
The working calculations expose assumptions and failure conditions; they are not forecasts or observed commercial results.
Two core livelihoods is a stress test, not a claim that two people are an optimal company size.
The separate apple edge is not evidence for or against the general FAF architecture.
Publication makes the model inspectable; it does not establish legal, tax, equipment, demand or economic validity for a real deployment.
